description: PHP class VTCacheUtils providing caching utilities for module, field, user, currency, role, and report information in vtiger CRM.

classes.name: VTCacheUtils
classes.description: A utility class for caching various data in vtiger CRM, including tab info, field info, user data, currency info, role info, and report info.

methods.name: lookupTabid
methods.description: Retrieve tab ID for a given module name from cache.

methods.name: lookupModulename
methods.description: Retrieve module name for a given tab ID from cache.

methods.name: updateTabidInfo
methods.description: Update cache with tab ID and module name.

methods.name: lookupAllTabsInfo
methods.description: Retrieve cached information of all tabs.

methods.name: updateAllTabsInfo
methods.description: Update cache with information of all tabs.

methods.name: updateFieldInfo
methods.description: Store field information cache for a specific tab.

methods.name: lookupFieldInfo
methods.description: Retrieve field info for a specific tab and field name.

methods.name: lookupFieldInfo_Module
methods.description: Retrieve field info for all fields in a module, filtered by presence.

methods.name: lookupFieldInfoByColumn
methods.description: Retrieve field info by column name for a specific tab.

methods.name: updateModuleColumnFields
methods.description: Cache module's column fields.

methods.name: lookupModuleColumnFields
methods.description: Retrieve cached column fields for a module.

methods.name: lookupUserCurrenyId
methods.description: Retrieve user's currency ID, checking current user context.

methods.name: updateUserCurrencyId
methods.description: Cache user's currency ID.

methods.name: lookupCurrencyInfo
methods.description: Get currency information from cache.

methods.name: updateCurrencyInfo
methods.description: Update cache with currency information.

methods.name: updateUserProfileId
methods.description: Cache user profile ID.

methods.name: lookupUserProfileId
methods.description: Retrieve user profile ID from cache.

methods.name: lookupProfile2FieldPermissionList
methods.description: Retrieve profile-to-field permission list for a module and profile ID.

methods.name: updateProfile2FieldPermissionList
methods.description: Update profile-to-field permission list cache.

methods.name: lookupRoleSubordinates
methods.description: Get subordinate roles for a role ID.

methods.name: updateRoleSubordinates
methods.description: Cache subordinate roles for a role ID.

methods.name: clearRoleSubordinates
methods.description: Clear subordinate role cache, optionally for a specific role.

methods.name: lookupReport_ListofModuleInfos
methods.description: Retrieve cached list of report modules and related modules.

methods.name: updateReport_ListofModuleInfos
methods.description: Update cache with report modules and related modules.

methods.name: lookupReport_Info
methods.description: Retrieve report info for a user and report ID.

methods.name: updateReport_Info
methods.description: Update cache with report information.

methods.name: lookupReport_SubordinateUsers
methods.description: Get subordinate user IDs for a report.

methods.name: updateReport_SubordinateUsers
methods.description: Cache subordinate user IDs for a report.

methods.name: lookupReport_ScheduledInfo
methods.description: Retrieve scheduled report info for a user and report ID.

methods.name: updateReport_ScheduledInfo
methods.description: Cache scheduled report information.
